raw_sections.projects:
Key Projects Pharma Document Intelligence (RAG + AWS Bedrock + Claude) (cid:127) Designed and deployed an enterprise-grade Q&A; system to handle pharma regulatory and compliance documents using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) on AWS. (cid:127) Implemented document chunking, vector embeddings, and semantic search using AWS OpenSearch + LangChain for faster and more accurate retrieval. (cid:127) Integrated Claude LLM on AWS Bedrock for generating context-aware answers from pharma documents. (cid:127) Automated ingestion of PDFs and metadata using AWS Lambda and S3 pipelines. (cid:127) Reduced manual query resolution time by 50% with instant retrieval of compliance and drug data.
(cid:127) Ensured security compliance with HIPAA standards and internal governance. (cid:127) Built modular architecture supporting multi-domain document types (policy, SOP, drug research, and safety data).
GenAI Q&A; Platform (RAG + AWS + Claude) – Built an enterprise chatbot using LangChain, LangGraph, Claude, and AWS Bedrock. Used semantic search with vector DBs to improve response precision and latency.
Policy Document Assistant – Developed a secure AI assistant for compliance documents using RAG + Bedrock + Claude integration, improving internal policy query handling by 40%.
Code Summarization Tool – Created an internal summarizer using Transformers + LangChain to generate human-readable code documentation.
Data Automation Pipelines – Automated KPI dashboards with Python and SQL to reduce manual reporting time.
